odds_meta.label: model2.py
Inputs
odds_meta.value: Sleeper league box scores weeks 1-11 (players_points), live injury tags, real NFL schedule and byes (Wk13 BAL/IND/LV/NYJ, Wk14 DAL/ARI), real H2H pairings weeks 12-14, Sleeper weekly projections weeks 12-17 (35% of the forward mean).

odds_meta.label: Assumptions
odds_meta.value: 5,000 player-level season sims; Gamma weekly scores; availability from injury tags (IR .05, Out 0 this wk then .5, Doubtful .25 then .8, Questionable .78, healthy .96); 6-team playoff, top-2 byes, reseeded, weeks 15-17; seeding ties broken on real points-for carried through the sim. Zero odds shown as 0, under 1% as 0.5.
